candidate.workload: Actual Topocode self-demo logical overview followed by expansion of the real unassigned semantic inventory.

limitations: One candidate-bound run on one machine and browser; not a broad repository-scale or cross-hardware guarantee.
The logical overview intentionally aggregates the full semantic inventory into responsibility boxes; expansion measures the real unassigned member population.
Delivered FPS retains every callback and intersecting interval in the measured browser-clock window; long intervals are not removed.
